items.title: Scan Nightclub Posters With Phone Camera to Unlock Secret Radio Stations
items.summary: Pull up Jason or Lucia's smartphone camera inside underground clubs (like The Vault in Downtown Vice City) and scan illuminated posters behind the DJ booth to unlock hidden radio frequencies on your station wheel.
items.controls: PS5: D-Pad Up -> Camera | Xbox: D-Pad Up -> Camera

items.title: Apollo Aggregates (Red Barn) 4-Bag Trunk Restock Loop (~$55K/Run)
items.summary: Load 4 duffel bags from the open red barn and loading-bay truck into a 4-slot trunk, manually save on Slot #15 and reload to restock the yard, then fence at Brian's Lockup (Keypad Code: 7700).

items.title: Verified Code 0420 (Brian's Boutique Lab Back Room) + 7 Launch Keypads
items.summary: Players confirmed keypad combination 0420 unlocks Brian's boutique lab back room alongside verified launch codes 7700 (Brian's Lockup — Lab Fees acid stash), 4444, 0300, 6823, 6969, 2727, and 44017.

items.title: 4 Fully Playable In-Game Retro Arcade & Console Games Found
items.summary: Safehouses and Vice Beach arcades hide 4 playable mini-games including classic top-down arcade shooters and retro console cartridges that track local high scores.

items.title: On-Foot Pseudo First-Person Camera Workaround (No Native FPS Toggle)
items.summary: GTA 6 launched without an on-foot first-person camera toggle, but combining closest third-person view, corner cover (R1/RB), phone camera, and Aim (L2/LT) + exit cover locks an eye-level POV.
items.controls: PS5: R1 + D-Pad Up -> L2 | Xbox: RB + D-Pad Up -> LT

items.title: Gellhorn Foggy Haunted Hotel & Dynamic Billboard Puzzle
items.summary: Visiting the abandoned art-deco resort on the Port Gellhorn outskirts between 00:00 and 05:00 triggers thick fog, shifting mannequins, rooftop notebook clues, and a warped neon billboard.

items.title: Xbox Series X 120Hz VRR Refresh Handshake Unlocks Variable 40–50 FPS
items.summary: Toggling the 4K/VRR refresh handshake via Xbox Dashboard while Quick Resuming Build 01.002.001 temporarily lifts the 30 FPS cap on 120Hz HDMI 2.1 displays (test on Slot #15).

items.title: Dexter Morgan Apartment, AC Stash & 'Slice of Life' Boat in Vice Beach
items.summary: Inspect Trinity Apartments on northern Washington Island to spot the window AC slide stash, rooftop kit, and the weathered boat 'Slice of Life' docked behind the marina.
